fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Article-mode records (S1-urql) are explicit fields extracted from the Apollo/urql GraphQL cache embedded in __NEXT_DATA__ (theatlantic.com's JSON-LD is metadata-only and lacks articleBody, so full text is reconstructed from ArticleParagraphContent blocks). Latest-mode records (S2-atom) come from The Atlantic's Atom feed (not RSS 2.0), kept teaser-only (summary) for consistency with this portfolio's other 'latest' modes.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest'/'latest:<section>') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (S1-urql or S2-atom).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- the error kind.

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Article title, from the urql article cache (article-mode).

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description: Full article text, reconstructed by concatenating and HTML-stripping ArticleParagraphContent blocks' innerHtml (article-mode).

url.title: URL
url.description: Canonical article URL, or the input URL if not present upstream (article-mode).

author.title: Author(s)
author.description: List of {name, url} objects for each byline author (article-mode).

hasMeter.title: Has meter
hasMeter.description: Whether the article is paywall-metered, as reported upstream (article-mode).

primaryCategory.title: Primary category
primaryCategory.description: Display name of the article's primary category/section (article-mode).

contentBlockCount.title: Content block count
contentBlockCount.description: Total number of content blocks (paragraphs, images, embeds) in the urql article.content list, before filtering to paragraphs only (article-mode).

title.title: Title
title.description: Entry title from the Atom feed (latest mode).

link.title: Link
link.description: Article URL, from the Atom entry's rel=alternate link (latest mode).

authors.title: Authors (feed)
authors.description: List of author name strings, supporting multiple co-bylines (latest mode).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
